scope: Reference-only physical qualification. No target measurement, inverse position, held-out receiver, orbit comparison or S3 claim.

selection.rule: Choose the earliest common 11-endpoint 30 s window for which every fixed station has at least four lexicographically selected non-target GPS references with C1C/C2W/L1C/L2W present, blank-or-zero phase LLI and reference-only broadcast elevation at least 15 degrees at every endpoint. Measurement magnitudes and residuals cannot affect selection.

design_covariance.interpretation: Fixed weighting convention inherited from S2 development; not a calibrated receiver probability model. Admission also uses deterministic residual limits.

threshold_basis.code: Unchanged G14 reference-calibration limits; reused without looking at DOY252 observations.
threshold_basis.phase_rate: The 0.05 m/s S1 design scale is treated as a deterministic capability requirement, not an empirical 95 percent claim.
threshold_basis.envelope: A later distinct primary may use at least twice the largest admitted qualification residual; this qualification cannot establish population coverage.

stop: One fixed date, eight fixed roots, first structure-and-reference-geometry-selected common window, one outcome. Missing source, changed receiver, structural failure, unavailable reference model or threshold failure closes the qualification without station/window substitution.
